description:
**Manager | Java Springboot Full Stack | Coimbatore | Engineering | Platform Development & Integration**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 114968
  
• **Location**: Coimbatore
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert them into accurate, actionable information that supports fact-driven decision-making and digital transformation. Our practice spans cloud, application modernization, enterprise integration, analytics, engineering, and next-generation technologies across industries including Energy, Utilities, Manufacturing, and Industrial Automation.

  

**Your Work Profile**

Experienced Java & AWS Technical Lead to lead the design and delivery of scalable, cloud-native enterprise applications while providing technical direction to engineering teams.

* Lead architecture, design, development, and delivery of Java/Spring Boot and AWS solutions.
* Design microservices, REST APIs, event-driven and cloud-native architectures.
* Drive use of AWS services including EKS/ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, and CloudWatch.
* Provide technical leadership, conduct code/design reviews, and mentor engineering teams.
* Drive CI/CD, DevOps, security, performance, scalability, and reliability best practices.
* Collaborate with architects, product teams, and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Support technical solutioning, estimation, POCs, and application modernization initiatives.
  

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience with strong hands-on coding experience with Java 17+, Spring Boot, and AWS.
* Hands-on experience with AWS API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, S3, and RDS.
* Strong understanding of Event-Driven Architecture and API Design Patterns.
* Experience with AWS CloudWatch, Log Insights, and log analytics for distributed tracing and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding and implementation experience with OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization.
* Experience with Microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems, and messaging.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, SQL/NoSQL databases, and cloud-native development.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor development teams.

**Location and Way of Working**

* Coimbatore

title: .NET Full Stack Developer - US Client Engagement & AI Solutions
description:
We are seeking a talented **.NET Full Stack Developer** with a passion for **AI Solutions** and client\-facing engagements to join our dynamic team in Coimbatore. In this role, you will work closely with **US\-based clients**, bridging business requirements with cutting\-edge technical execution. The ideal candidate should have **6 months to 1 year of experience** in C\# and .NET development, along with a strong foundation in modern cloud architectures, REST APIs, and basic AI/ML integrations. If you thrive in agile environments and want to build the next generation of intelligent software, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

* **Client Engagement \& Collaboration:** Directly interact with US\-based stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical updates, and deliver robust software solutions tailored to their business objectives.
* **Full Stack Development:** Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality, scalable applications using **C\#, .NET Core, and modern front\-end frameworks**.
* **AI Solutions Integration:** Integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities (such as GCP Vertex AI, ADK, MCP and LLM\-based APIs) into enterprise applications.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Leverage **Azure Services** and utilize **Docker** for containerization, collaborating with the DevOps team to streamline continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* **API \& Database Management:** Build, secure, and consume **REST APIs**, managing backend data efficiently using **SQL** and modern database technologies.
* **Code Quality \& Agile Delivery:** Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following **Agile Scrum methodologies**, actively participating in code reviews and architecture discussions.
* **Performance \& Security:** Implement industry best practices for application security, scalability, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex software issues.

Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Professional experience in **C\# and .NET Core development**.
* **AI \& Cloud Acumen:** Familiarity or hands\-on experience integrating AI solutions
* **Client\-Facing Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven experience or readiness to manage **US client communications and presentations**.
* **Core Technical Stack:** Strong working knowledge of **REST APIs, SQL, and modern front\-end technologies**.
* **DevOps \& Containerization:** Familiarity with **Docker**, containerization, and basic DevOps practices.
* **Methodology \& Soft Skills:** Strong understanding of **Agile Scrum**, exceptional problem\-solving abilities, high attention to detail, and the capability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.

Pay: ₹144,000\.00 \- ₹240,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* What is your notice Period? How soon you can join if you selected for this role?
* Why you want to switch the current company?
* Do you have any offers in hand? if any provide the details
* What is your experience in .Net?
* Have you worked with Onsite/ Oversea Clients and or Development Team?
* Are you good with working on Alternate Saturdays? (We will mostly use this Alternate Saturday for internal meeting, Trainings and Catchup on the sprint tasks.)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person
